## Summary

- Catalog can turn a Source table's Mirror on or off. Operations shows the Mirror fleet, inventory, diagnostics, journal, and a setup guide. Saving that switch records desired state. This image does not start capture.
- An Entity Data offset query accepts one `sort`. Page size follows the System Parameter `entity_page_limit_max` (seed 200, range 50–10000). An omitted `limit` stays 50. Entity MCP `query_rows` uses the same ceiling and does not accept `sort`.
- Job and schedule Job projections include `is_delayed_recovery`. Existing rows are false. The console shows a Delayed recovery badge only when it is true, and shows Created and Started on one Time column.
- MySQL Controlled Query, Catalog Sample, a channel live Source query, and Metadata MCP `run_sql` return a binary cell as `{"encoding":"base64","data":"..."}` and a `DECIMAL` cell as an exact decimal string.
- Source forms group connector settings by engine, protect a saved connection, and offer Capture Precheck.
- Settings can store a notification channel. Delivery stays off until the optional deployer environment is set.

## Operator notes

- Upgrade from v0.10.0. v0.1.6 and v0.1.9 were tagged and are not installable. Do not install them.
- The minor bump is for existing contracts. MySQL binary cells were JSON strings and `DECIMAL` cells were JSON numbers; both change shape. Channel publish confirmation no longer includes `mirrors_to_open` (it was always `[]`). `limits.page_limit_max` on Entity schema and `describe_entity` is the live parameter, not a fixed 200. The seed is still 200, so a request that was accepted at the old ceiling is still accepted until an operator raises the parameter.
- No new keys in `.env.example`. Leave the live `.env` in place. The release attaches the example as `default.env.example`. Optional `REFRAQ_MIRROR_TARGET`, `REFRAQ_NOTIFICATION_REVIEWED_ORIGINS`, `REFRAQ_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY`, and the private capture runtime file are not in that example and are not required to start. Unset, the Mirror target stays unbound and notification delivery stays disabled.
- Download this release's `docker-compose.yaml` and `prometheus.yml` and replace both site files. Do not overwrite the live `.env`.
- Compose still mounts named volume `refraq_pg` at `/var/lib/postgresql`. Default PGDATA is `/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker`. A site already on that mount keeps its cluster. A site that only used the published v0.1.8 asset must still copy the anonymous-volume cluster onto `refraq_pg` before `up -d`, using the command in the v0.1.10 notes. Do not run `docker compose down -v`. Do not restore `/var/lib/postgresql/data`.
- Replace the files, then `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. The new image tag recreates `ensure-entity-db` (`restart: "no"`). That one-shot replaces `entity_access.profile_page_sql` and `entity_access.profile_page` and removes the old 201-row business cap. It does not delete Entity rows. API, worker, Beat, and Entity MCP wait for that one-shot. Do not point the new processes at the old functions.
- API start runs Foundation Upgrade from `0090_entity_index_state` through `0106_mirror_throughput`. It adds Source capture columns, `jobs.is_delayed_recovery` (false on existing rows), and Mirror management tables. Existing catalog rows, Entity rows, channel definitions, checkpoints, and run records stay. Rolling back to an older image after this upgrade is not supported.
- `mirror:read` and `mirror:write` are new. Super Admin follows the permission catalog and receives them without a role edit. A custom role does not. Mirror HTTP stays forbidden until that role is granted.
- A draft that contains `read.mirror`, or a `config.source` field on `read.changes` or `volume.changes_dataset`, fails validation with `CHANNEL_NODE_INPUT_WITHDRAWN`. v0.10.0 did not accept those inputs. Entity change inputs stay on `entity_id`.
- Deleting a Source that holds a capture binding returns `409 SOURCE_CAPTURE_RESOURCES_RETAINED`, including when capture is disabled. A Source with no capture binding still deletes as before. There is no ordinary release endpoint.
- Webhook delivery is unchanged. Metadata MCP tool arguments are unchanged apart from MySQL cell values in `run_sql` rows. Entity MCP `query_rows` still has no `sort` argument; its `limit` ceiling follows `entity_page_limit_max`.
